text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel selecting a man over another man gives you no grievance on grounds of sex — if anything, the composition points away from bias against you. Raising it would read as grasping and could undermine the part of your complaint that is solid.

What is solid: the unanswered request. Most civil service frameworks require a written explanation within a set period, and two weeks of silence is a genuine procedural failing. Chase it in writing, cite the relevant policy, and ask specifically how the criteria were scored and what weight "leading international projects" carried against your law degree and ten years' service. If the scoring looks constructed after the fact, that is your real argument.
